subject.title: feat(discord): support multiple file attachments per message (fixes #24196)

question: Should Discord officially batch `mediaUrls` into native multi-attachment messages, with component and voice modes remaining single-attachment-only?
rationale: This adds a public message-action capability and deliberately changes physical delivery and error semantics; tests can prove implementation behavior but cannot choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Adopt Native Batching
options.body: Repair the multipart Blob regression, preserve scalar compatibility, and accept documented batching plus explicit component and voice restrictions.

options.title: Keep Sequential Delivery
options.body: Do not add the plural Discord input and retain the generic one-attachment-per-message behavior.

options.title: Narrow the Feature
options.body: Support native batching only in ordinary outbound payloads while deferring action and component contract changes to separate work.

recommendation.title: Adopt Native Batching
recommendation.body: Repair the multipart Blob regression, preserve scalar compatibility, and accept documented batching plus explicit component and voice restrictions.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a user-visible channel contract decision rather than a purely mechanical code repair.
